name: omniroute-coder-desktop
description: Windows desktop build of OmniRoute Coder (Electron wrapping the standalone Next server).
author: OmniRoute
_comment_asar: asar is disabled (see electron-builder.yml). The app spawns payload/.next/standalone/server.js as a child process by path and loads better-sqlite3's .node from disk; both must be real files, not entries inside an asar archive. For a 10-person beta the tradeoff (larger, readable source) is acceptable and removes a whole class of path bugs.
